title: Why Pirates Didn't Really Have Parrots #Shorts
description:
Most pirates never had a parrot on their shoulder. Sailors did bring parrots back from the tropics. But for pirates, a parrot was usually cargo, something to sell. In the port markets of Jamaica, exotic birds were sold for good money.
